# CityMETER Industrial Estate

> Thailand's industrial estates, parks and zones (106 catalogue records of the industrial-estate research master, registry research.TH.industrial_estates, data contract industrial-estate-demo/1.0.0) on a map: the 46 OpenStreetMap outlines the master selected for the demo, IEAT factory-directory listings per estate (snapshot 2026-11-04), name candidates in CityMETER Factory, estate, parent-company or developer logos, and the CityMETER Factory registrations within 3 km of each outline. Since release 1.2.0 (2026-11-16) the workers of the around-estate sets follow CityMETER Factory 0.9.0: DIW figures first, the MOI TOTAL_WORKER only where DIW has none, shown apart (“กรอ. … · อก. เติม …”); registrations without a DIW industry group are “ไม่ระบุกลุ่มอุตสาหกรรม”, never a ranked industry. Since release 1.3.0 (2026-11-17) the map draws what the register's R9 review (30_DEMO_COVERAGE_R9, 2026-11-10) lets the demo draw: 64 estates from 66 OpenStreetMap parts kept apart, 3 context areas drawn apart and never counted as outlines, each with the register's label and note beside it; 39 records still have no outline. Since release 1.3.1 (2026-11-17) opening an estate draws every building that meets its outline (all its parts) in 3D at once, on a phone too; buildings beyond a drawn outline are not the estate's. A Landometer CityMETER public demo, release 1.3.1 (2026-11-17). Thai and English (?lang=en).

- Pages: https://montri-th.github.io/factory/industrialestate/ and https://citymeter.pages.dev/industrialestate/
- Address: ?d=industrialEstate&at=<province code>&e=estate:<estate_id> (citymeter-shell grammar)
- Data: data/estates.json (records), data/boundaries.geojson (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0), data/directory.json (IEAT directory by estate), data/around.json (Factory points round each outline)
- Method and limits: DATA_METHOD.md · product statement: PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md
- Companion demo: CityMETER Factory, https://montri-th.github.io/factory/ (?d=factory&e=estate:<estate_id> opens the same estate)

Counts: 106 records in 21 provinces (84 industrial estates, 16 parks, 6 zones); 64 outlines from 66 OpenStreetMap source parts and 3 context areas (R9, release 1.3.0; 46 outlines before); 6,811 directory listings in 56 estates (50 estates have no listing in this snapshot: no data, not zero); verified factories: no data.

Do not claim from this data: the number of factories, tenants, companies, workers or jobs in an estate; that a registration within 3 km is inside or a member of an estate; a legal or current estate boundary, its area or a density; a ranking of estates.
